{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/profiles.py:8:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:9:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:10:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:15:test-failure"], "search": "    bio: Optional[str]
    website: Optional[str]
    age: Optional[int]", "replace": "    bio: Optional[str] = None
    website: Optional[str] = None
    age: Optional[int] = None", "explanation": "Per the Pydantic V2 migration guide (Required, optional, and nullable fields), `Optional[T]` without a default is required in V2, whereas V1 defaulted it to None. Adding `= None` restores the V1 behavior (not required, can be None), matching the table entry `f4: Optional[str] = None`. This also resolves the test failure at line 15: profile_from_form drops blank/None form values, so omitted bio/website/age previously raised 'Field required'; with defaults they become None, as the test `test_blank_fields_become_none` expects. No change to profile_from_form is needed."}], "notes": "Single edit covers all four findings. The three optional-no-default findings (lines 8-10) are fixed directly by adding `= None`, which matches the V1 implicit default. The test-failure finding (line 15) has the same root cause: profile_from_form filters out blank values, so the now-missing optional keys must have defaults. The function body is left unchanged. `interests: List[str] = []` is already a non-required field with a default, and pydantic v2 copies mutable defaults per instance, so it needs no change. The `typing` import is still used (List, Optional), so no import changes are needed."}
